methodologyNotes: Covers powered paint sprayers sold at a published US price for architectural and finishing work — airless, high-efficiency airless (HEA), HVLP turbine, and handheld/cordless airless units. Excludes airbrushes, pneumatic detail guns that require a separately purchased shop compressor with no bundled turbine, agricultural/pump garden sprayers, and texture hoppers. Price is US MSRP or typical street price in USD. sprayerType is an enum: airless, hea-airless, hvlp, or handheld-airless. powerSource is an enum: corded-electric, battery, gas, or pneumatic. maxPressurePsi is maximum operating pressure in PSI; null for low-pressure HVLP turbine systems that do not publish a PSI rating. maxFlowGpm is maximum material output in US gallons per minute; null if not published. maxTipSizeIn is the largest supported spray-tip orifice diameter in inches; null for tipless/HVLP nozzle systems. motorPowerHp is rated motor or pump power in horsepower; null if not published. hoseLengthFt is the included spray-hose length in feet; 0 for cup- or tank-fed handhelds with no hose. annualUseGal is the manufacturer-recommended maximum annual throughput in US gallons; null if not published. containerCapacityOz is the capacity of the integrated cup, tank, or hopper in US fluid ounces; null for bucket-draw or suction-tube units that feed from an external pail. weightLbs is bare tool/unit weight in pounds. tipsIncluded is the integer count of spray tips or nozzles supplied in the box.

products.name: Graco Magnum X7
products.priceNote: US MSRP $519.00, listed verbatim as "$519.00 USD MSRP" on the official Graco product page (262805-magnum-x7). The corroborating Pittsburgh Spray Equipment retailer listing is MAP-gated (price hidden until cart), so it does not restate a figure.
products.provenance: The official Graco product page (Part Number 262805, "Magnum X7 Electric TrueAirless Sprayer") confirms the exact model and lists a $519.00 USD MSRP, plus a full technical spec table: Type Airless Sprayer, Power Source Electric/120V, 3000 psi max working pressure, 0.31 GPM max flow, 0.017 in max tip, 0.625 HP motor, 125 gal recommended annual usage, 27 lb weight, an included "1/4 in x 25 ft DuraFlex Hose" and a single TrueAirless 515 spray tip.
